9:27.text: Then after that Allâh will accept the repentance of whom He wills. And Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

9:28.text: (in Allâh’s Oneness and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
(polytheists, pagans, idolaters, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, and in the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
So let them not come near Al-Masjidal-Harâm
after this year; and if you fear poverty, Allâh will enrich you if He wills, out of His Bounty. Surely, Allâh is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

9:29.text: nor forbid that which has been forbidden by Allâh and His Messenger Muhammad
and those who acknowledge not the religion of truth
among the people of the Scripture
with willing submission, and feel themselves subdued.

9:30.text: is the son of Allâh, and the Christians say: Messiah is the son of Allâh. That is their saying with their mouths, resembling the saying of those who disbelieved aforetime. Allâh’s Curse be on them, how they are deluded away from the truth!

9:31.text: took their rabbis and their monks to be their lords besides Allâh
(by obeying them in things which they made lawful or unlawful according to their own desires without being ordered by Allâh)
to worship none but One Ilâh
(none has the right to be worshipped but He)
. Praise and glory be to Him
from having the partners they associate
